panels.label: 上脚展示
panels.copy_purpose: 符合鞋型和用途的自然穿着展示
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact shoe or pair correctly worn on an adult model's feet in a natural category-appropriate stance.
panels.backdrop_en: Refined minimal urban or studio walking environment.
panels.composition_en: Use a lower-body crop, show complete shoe profiles and ground contact, and keep the left side calm.
panels.lighting_en: Natural directional light revealing upper and sole materials.

panels.label: 侧面轮廓
panels.copy_purpose: 鞋楦、鞋面、鞋底和整体比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a clean exact side or three-quarter product profile preserving the last shape, upper, sole, heel, toe, and fastening system.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete footwear profile in the upper-middle and reserve the lower area.
panels.lighting_en: Large soft light with precise edge and sole definition.

panels.label: 材质工艺
panels.copy_purpose: 完整鞋型中突出鞋面纹理、缝线、系带、鞋底或跟部结构
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete footwear quantity in a detail-led construction photograph, using angle and light to reveal upper texture, seams, fastening, sole, tread, or heel details visible in the reference.
panels.composition_en: Keep every complete shoe and its full sole, toe, and heel inside frame; make defining details readable on the left and reserve the upper-right.
panels.lighting_en: Raking daylight with realistic textile, leather, rubber, or hardware response.

panels.label: 使用场景
panels.copy_purpose: 适合鞋型的运动、通勤或休闲环境
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact footwear in a believable category-appropriate movement or daily-use moment without obscuring it.
panels.backdrop_en: Sparse premium environment suitable for the observed footwear type.
panels.composition_en: Keep footwear visible in the lower-right and preserve the upper-left for copy.
panels.lighting_en: Warm commercial lifestyle light with realistic contact shadows.

panels.label: 成对主视觉
panels.copy_purpose: 保持输入数量的完整静物广告主视觉
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a premium studio hero image showing exactly the reference quantity; do not turn a single shoe into a pair or a pair into extra shoes.
panels.composition_en: Arrange the exact footwear quantity slightly left and reserve a quiet lower-right.
panels.lighting_en: Controlled campaign light defining silhouette, sole, and texture.
